title: Good bike rental
text: One of the only ones that was open on Sunday. Bikes were in good condition, better than previous experience in Sevilla and Cadiz. Frinedly and helpful.
author: RienkW

title: Cycling and flamenco combined.
text: We bought a package that inclouded flamenco tickets and a boat cruise at standard prices, but also tossed in a free half day of bike rental for two. Alejandro, the owner was very knowledgeable about the cycling and routes to the Roman ruins, and the bikes were in excellent shape.  He also provided advice on when to see the flamenco show, and arranged excellent seats on the night we asked for. He offers tours of the city, and arranged multi day tours from Seville via backroads to other cities in Andalucía, something we may take him up on next trip.
author: David B

title: Going to Seville - Road Biking Excellence!
text: Alex and his staff were great to work with.   I needed a road bike for 2 weeks - he got me a great carbon fiber, ultegra equipped bike; sorted all details - got it fitted easily; provided a great rate for the length of time; communicated easily; provided a route - which for new roadies to Seville - highly recommend N630 going towards Portugal - lots of roadies, some challenging climbs; few vehicles - and those on the road were very courteous.    The store in Triana is well located to get to N630.    A roady delight!   Would love to return and do it again with Alex and co.
author: Clyde S

title: Excellent service
text: We rented two bicycles, as the city, having many cycle paths, makes it very easy to get around. The vehicles are in excellent condition, very comfortable and fast. Very kind owner.
author: Marco C

title: Top bike rental in Seville (Triana district)
text: Excellent bicycles, good fair prices in the Triana district of Seville. Cross the bridge and you are in the center. Yellow standard bicycles or more sporty ones (black). Also cycling tours and guided tours. Super friendly owner who is building a great business. Website in good order. If you rent a bicycle in suitcase storage, it is even free, otherwise for a small fee. Reliable and neat, what more could you want.
author: Boristopper

title: Very quick and easy
text: Really great place, super easy. We were late for an appointment and in a mad rush going in and they got us on bikes almost instantly. We easily got to our appointment on time. Thanks guys!!
author: jakezavracky

title: Pleasant day cycling round Seville
text: If staying in Tirana as we were then using these guys for bike hire makes sense. All very simple with no fuss. The bikes are functional without being exciting but at €13 a day per bike it’s good value. We cycled around 20km in a wide loop around the city with no problems.
author: Mackthedan

title: Great Cycling and Service
text: Great bikes and friendly staff Possibility of storage luggage, convenient on a last day.
author: marlov2018

title: Helpful owner and good bikes
text: A friendly and helpful owner. The bike was in good working order.   Store is located in Great location in Triana.  Right next to bridge and easy access to the river biking path
author: nylonkong

title: Recommended!
text: The five of us wanted to explore Seville by bike. We have been helped very well: tailor-made bikes, route and tips! For 13 euros a day per bike that is not money
author: esselynj
